sources.entry: Nimbalyst by Greg Hinkle - A visual workspace for building with Claude Code (and Codex) where you and the agent co-edit *visually* — markdown, mockups, mermaid, Excalidraw, CSV, and data models — approving the agent's changes as red/green WYSIWYG diffs, with session/task kanban, worktrees, an extension SDK, and a native iOS companion app. A distinctive higher-bandwidth take on agent collaboration,

summary.one_liner: Nimbalyst is an open-source, MIT-licensed Electron desktop app (with an iOS companion) that gives you a visual workspace for co-editing files with coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.
summary.what_it_does: Nimbalyst provides WYSIWYG editors for markdown, mockups, Mermaid, Excalidraw, CSV, data models, and code (Monaco), where you and a coding agent edit the same files. Agent edits appear as red/green diffs in the rendered document, and you accept or reject each change. It runs multiple agent sessions in parallel, each isolated in its own git worktree, and shows them on a session kanban with search, resume, and links to touched files. It also includes task tracking that agents can read and update, built-in git management with AI-drafted commits, an embedded terminal, and an MCP client. An extension SDK lets you add editors for new file types, and the iOS app lets you check agent status, reply by text or voice, review diffs, and get notifications. Content is stored as plain files in your git repo.
use_cases: Reviewing and approving AI coding agent edits visually
Running several coding agents in parallel on separate branches
Editing markdown docs, diagrams, and mockups alongside an agent
Tracking plans, bugs, and todos that agents update
Managing git branches, worktrees, and commits with AI help
Checking and replying to agents from an iPhone
notable: Red/green WYSIWYG diff review of agent edits in the rendered document, not raw text
Each parallel agent session runs in its own git worktree
Every editor, including built-ins, uses the same EditorHost extension contract
Plain markdown and git-repo files on disk with no proprietary store
Native iOS companion app for status, voice replies, and diff approval
caveats: OpenCode and GitHub Copilot support are marked alpha
The collaboration sync server at wss://sync.nimbalyst.com is a separate project not contained in this repo
Anonymous usage analytics are sent to PostHog by default, with an opt-out in settings
